title: Mto wa Mbu: A Village Stop on the Safari Route
excerpt: Mto wa Mbu, at the gate of Lake Manyara, is a lively village with many cultures. A walk, a bike ride or lunch here is a nice break.
body:
## The name

Mto wa Mbu means "river of mosquitoes".

## Many cultures

Many ethnic groups live in and around the village, attracted by fertile land and water.

## What to do

- A village walk or bike ride with a local guide.
- Banana farms and banana beer.
- The market.
- Lunch with local food.
- Woodcarvers and painters.

## On your route

The village lies between Tarangire and Ngorongoro, next to [Lake Manyara](/blog/lake-manyara-guide/).

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
